provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Casting Shadows rulebook (Unstable Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player chooses a Character: Player Board and matching Meeple
HP Tracker on {hp}, Shadow Tracker on 0; Base Form side up (HP tracker on the right)
Room right of your board for your Spell Book (5 slots); take a reference card if you like
Ancient Rune Hex in the center; Dusty Desert and Underground Volcano Hexes on opposite sides of it
Youngest player is Player 1, then clockwise
Each player places their Home Hex as shown and their Meeple on it
steps.note: Frill - Lilypad, Kit - Gale, Nuzzle - Thornwood, Haze - Greentongue

steps.text: Shuffle the Counterspell deck facedown next to the Dusty Desert Hex
Shuffle the Main deck; flip 1 card faceup next to each Hex around the Ancient Rune Hex, except the Dusty Desert; rest facedown, room for a discard pile
Shuffle the Companion deck facedown; flip {n} faceup as the Companion Portal
All tokens and dice within reach
Player 1 goes first, then clockwise; last player standing wins
